from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import statistics
import subprocess

r = Path(os.environ['TEMP']) / 'llmx-prefill-reduction'
models = {
    'q8': Path.home() / '.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/snapshots/23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf',
    'f32': r.parent / 'Qwen3-0.6B-F32.gguf',
}
tokens = r.parent / 'llmx-external-perf/eight-pairs/tokens.txt'
assert hashlib.sha256(tokens.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'c20c52dde29e91550f51290e22a5a18d591fb98f1630397b38253ebf22d26c59'
reference = Path.home() / 'Desktop/Projects/llmx-ref/build/bin/Release/llmx-compare-threads.exe'
executables = {arm: r / (arm + '-compare.exe') for arm in ('control', 'candidate')}
executables['mx'] = reference
rows = []
hashes = {}

def user_processes():
    return subprocess.check_output(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command',
        "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='llmx.exe'\" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId"], text=True).strip()

def save():
    (r / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')

for pair in range(-1, 9):
    for model in (list(models) if pair % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(models))):
        for arm in (list(executables) if pair % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(executables))):
            active = user_processes()
            if active:
                raise RuntimeError('User inference present; timing not started: ' + active)
            cmd = [str(executables[arm]), str(models[model]), str(tokens), '--threads', '6']
            p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
            name = f'{model}-pair{pair}-{arm}'
            (r / (name + '.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout)
            (r / (name + '.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
            active = user_processes()
            if active:
                (r / (name + '.contended')).write_text(active)
                raise RuntimeError('User inference appeared; raw sample retained but not admitted: ' + active)
            p.check_returncode()
            records = [json.loads(line) for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith(b'{')]
            assert len(records) == 2
            assert [x['run'] for x in records] == [0, 1]
            for record in records:
                assert record['threads'] == 6 and record['pp_tokens'] == 215 and record['tg_tokens'] == 32
                assert record['pp_ms'] > 0 and record['tg_ms'] > 0
            if arm != 'mx':
                h = [line.split()[1].decode() for line in p.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(b'vector_hash ')]
                assert len(h) == 2 and h[0] == h[1]
                if model in hashes:
                    assert hashes[model] == h[1], (model, arm, pair, h)
                hashes[model] = h[1]
            rows.append(dict(model=model, pair=pair, arm=arm, command=cmd, records=records))
            save()
            print(name, 'pass', flush=True)

summary = []
for model in models:
    for phase, count in (('pp', 215), ('tg', 32)):
        item = dict(model=model, phase=phase)
        for arm in executables:
            samples = [1000 * count / row['records'][1][phase + '_ms'] for row in rows
                       if row['model'] == model and row['arm'] == arm and row['pair'] >= 0]
            assert len(samples) == 9
            item[arm] = dict(mean=statistics.mean(samples), median=statistics.median(samples),
                             minimum=min(samples), maximum=max(samples), samples=samples)
        item['candidate_paired_wins'] = sum(a > b for a, b in zip(item['candidate']['samples'], item['control']['samples']))
        summary.append(item)
(r / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(rows=summary, final_vector_hashes=hashes), indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import struct
import subprocess

r = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
temp = r.parent
out = r / 'numerical'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
models = {
    'f32': temp / 'Qwen3-0.6B-F32.gguf',
    'q8': Path.home() / '.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/snapshots/23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf',
}
hf = temp / 'llmx-attention-long'
targets = json.loads((hf / 'hf-generated.json').read_text())
assert len(targets) == 32
assert list(map(int, (temp / 'llmx-q8-integer/hf-continuation.txt').read_text().split())) == targets
suffixes = ['-logits.f32'] + [f'-step-{i:02d}.f32' for i in range(32)]
report = {'scope': '1943-token prefill plus 32 HF continuation tokens; four separate serial-step NLL cases, not full corpus/max context',
          'bounds_declared_before_run': {'f32_max_abs_hf_logit_error': 0.001,
                                         'f32_max_abs_hf_continuation_nll_delta': 0.0001,
                                         'q8_max_abs_hf_continuation_nll_delta': 0.01}}

def run(name, command):
    print('START', name, flush=True)
    p = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in command], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    (out / (name + '.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout)
    (out / (name + '.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
    p.check_returncode()
    return p.stdout

def values(data):
    assert len(data) == 151936 * 4
    result = [x[0] for x in struct.iter_unpack('<f', data)]
    assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in result)
    return result

def loss(logits, target):
    top = max(logits)
    return top + math.log(math.fsum(math.exp(x - top) for x in logits)) - logits[target]

for model, path in models.items():
    ppl = {}
    for arm in ('control', 'candidate'):
        prefix = out / (model + '-' + arm)
        tool = 'long' if model == 'f32' else 'forced'
        cmd = [r / (arm + '-' + tool + '.exe'), path, temp / 'llmx-f32-controls/prompt.txt', prefix]
        if tool == 'forced':
            cmd.append(temp / 'llmx-q8-integer/hf-continuation.txt')
        ids = list(map(int, run(model + '-' + arm + '-long', cmd).split()))
        assert len(ids) == 32
        if model == 'f32':
            assert ids == targets, (model, arm, 'HF greedy IDs differ')
        ppl[arm] = [json.loads(line) for line in run(model + '-' + arm + '-ppl',
            [r / (arm + '-ppl.exe'), path, temp / 'llmx-external-perf/eight-pairs/tokens.txt']).splitlines()]
        assert len(ppl[arm]) == 4
    assert ppl['control'] == ppl['candidate']
    hashes = {}
    count = 0
    maximum = 0.0
    squared = 0.0
    nll = {'control': [], 'candidate': [], 'hf': []}
    for step, suffix in enumerate(suffixes):
        a = (out / (model + '-control' + suffix)).read_bytes()
        b = (out / (model + '-candidate' + suffix)).read_bytes()
        assert a == b, (model, suffix, 'control/candidate differ')
        bv = values(b)
        hv = values((hf / ('hf' + suffix)).read_bytes())
        if model == 'f32':
            for x, y in zip(bv, hv):
                d = abs(x - y)
                maximum = max(maximum, d)
                squared += d * d
        hashes[suffix] = hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
        count += len(bv)
        if step < 32:
            nll['control'].append(loss(values(a), targets[step]))
            nll['candidate'].append(loss(bv, targets[step]))
            nll['hf'].append(loss(hv, targets[step]))
    means = {arm: math.fsum(losses) / len(losses) for arm, losses in nll.items()}
    assert nll['control'] == nll['candidate']
    delta = abs(means['candidate'] - means['hf'])
    assert delta <= (0.0001 if model == 'f32' else 0.01), (model, delta)
    item = dict(logits_compared=count, vectors_byte_identical=True, vector_sha256=hashes,
                serial_nll_cases=ppl['candidate'], prefilled_continuation_mean_nll=means,
                prefilled_continuation_abs_hf_nll_delta=delta)
    if model == 'f32':
        assert maximum <= 0.001, maximum
        item.update(hf_greedy_ids_exact=32, max_abs_hf_logit_error=maximum,
                    rms_hf_logit_error=math.sqrt(squared / count))
    report[model] = item
    (out / 'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(model, 'PASS', count, 'exact logits; HF NLL delta', delta, flush=True)
print('ALL NUMERICAL CHECKS PASS', flush=True)
